name: May
source:
May is a young girl who has moved away from her parents' farm to Castle City, where the job prospects are endless. After securing a job as a barmaid, she's only worked there for a few days before strange events flip her life around. According to the other characters, she bears a strong resemblance to someone they once knew.

(Taken from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31456"]Lemma Soft thread[/url])
